name: ledger
description: /ledger prints each task ledger's goal, current step and next step; /ledger:task writes a backlog ledger for a separate task, or with --here gives the current worktree a ledger; /ledger:update writes the latest results to the ledger; /ledger:close writes the ledger and clears the session; /ledger:next does the same, then continues the task in the new session; /ledger:go <slug> does the same, then continues in the task named <slug>, first making the worktree of a backlog task; when the task the session worked on is finished, /ledger:next and /ledger:go first say how to retire it; /ledger:worktrees prints each linked git worktree's size, last commit, dirty files, ledger and PR; /ledger:retire archives a task's ledger, removes its worktree and deletes its merged branch; /ledger:park marks a task parked; /ledger:parent shows a parent task with each child task's status and next step, and adds or removes a child task; /ledger:archive searches archived ledgers; /ledger:all lists every task ledger on this machine, active, backlog and archived; /ledger:dashboard starts a local web page with that list, search, park and retire; /ledger:help lists these commands
